tool_contracts.insight: The 'refine' tool returns a structured analysis of method syntax and semantics, but does not guarantee completeness or accuracy of the content; its output must be verified by loading and inspecting the resulting note.
The 'generate-note' tool produces a new, independent output based on a prompt and style, even when the input is a static note, and is suitable for creating original evaluations when required.

The tool returns a collection of results, but the relevance of individual results must be verified by loading and inspecting content; not all results contain structured forecast data, even when the query is specific.
The 'load' tool cannot be applied to Notes that are already materialized (i.e., their content is part of the result collection); attempting to load such Notes results in an empty output.
The 'map' tool fails when applied to materialized Notes, returning an empty collection; it is only effective on non-materialized or dynamically accessible objects.
